name: model-router
description: Classifies each turn as mechanical, ordinary or hard and sets the model and reasoning effort to match, logging every decision

switch_main_model.title: Switch the main model
switch_main_model.description: Also change the main conversation's model per turn. Off by default: a model change resets the prompt cache. Subagents are routed either way.

set_effort.title: Set reasoning effort
set_effort.description: Set effort per tier: low for mechanical, medium for ordinary, high for hard.

cheap_model.title: Model for mechanical work
cheap_model.description: An alias or full model id.

strong_model.title: Model for hard work
strong_model.description: An alias or full model id.

classifier_model.title: Classifier model
classifier_model.description: The model that classifies each prompt.
